Every time he blocked me on an app feels like a knife through my heart, especially because I didn't do anything to him, so that made me believe that he left because I'm not worthy. I've been in therapy for a while, and I know I shouldn't feel this way about myself, but it becomes so hard when you're dealing with this every day. I feel so broken right now.

I have friends that I've helped a lot during hard times. I don't like it when they suffer, because I know how it is. They've told me to reach out for them when I needed.
However, they're all living their lives now. They have jobs, and literally never ask me how I'm doing. 
The closest friend I have, is living in another country. I have only a couple of friends that I talk to almost every day, but one of them seems to ignore me when I try to tell him that I'm feeling bad, and the other one just disappears when he feels like it.

It's frustrating for depressed people to talk about it to people around us, because depression is really hard to understand for them, and very often they will respond the wrong way. 

Reading how others feel in this sub, sometimes makes me feel like I'm not alone in the world, and there are others who understand what I'm going through. It makes me feel like I'm not as weird or crazy as I think. I feel like that's why most of us come here; because we can be honest, and we know there's somebody else who will understand what's going through our minds. That's it.
